E commerce content space through a phone call from CRAFT asking for some images to represent their products.
And as Ahmed has heard me say many times, I literally had no idea what they were talking about.
They're like e commerce content PDPs and I'm like, my head's exploding.
But I just hung onto the fact.
That it was a visual point of communication to consumers and I knew that kind of storytelling and those visuals, like I have the best people to tap into.

And that really launched us as premier, if you will.
You know, strategy and content creators for the PDPs for the digital shelf.

Those product display pages from the SEO Geo optimized titles and bullets and copy to, you know, we design the strategy and execution of how the carousel should be and the below the fold.
And we do all the videos.

As great partners with our team at.
Craft and that's gotten us some great.
Recognition for the work.

York City at the Paley Arts center with Diane von Furstenberg the other week.

Happy to answer any other questions.
That's great.

And we were talking mostly here like above the line, this is before like E Comm and pdp.

So the company really started from that place and then in the middle of the first decade of the century started moving more into Martech consultancy focused around digital asset management as both a technology and as sort of a practice area.
Our business continued with the sort of content creation that's part of the business that I run today.
It's our content studio as we call it.

But a lot of our business today is built on, is built on our MarTech consultancy and the service and how we service our global clients both on what their technology needs are moving forward, but also how to run and operate their platforms today.
And some of that includes content creation but it also includes handling of their assets, increasing the visibility of their assets.

They all have a lot of assets, they're all created by a lot of different agencies but they're not, they don't tend to be centralized and we help them think through strategies and that leads us to opportunities across definitely multi channel omnichannel universe right from, from big brand spots, big brand work to E Comm and to PDP and digital shelf.

So we wind up executing assets across all of the different paradigms of how their sales and marketing media are created but also encounter, how do they get that out to the globe, how do they protect their brand reputation as they, as they you know, transcreate across the world.
And so we like to say that our, our, our strategy and consultancy practice really helps brands think through how to do this at a global scale or whatever paradigm they're encountering.
And then our service groups are our managed content service groups and our content studio help our clients actually deliver that work to the market.

So yeah, so we're, we're, we're about, we're about 350 folks across the world and, and you know we're seeing incredible amount of change and appetite for change as things like automation and artificial intelligence really Kind of especially on the tech side, promise the ability for brands to do more and execute more with the same amount of resources or to reduce their resources and, and have in some cases a partnership between humans and machines to accomplish the same tasks that used to be all human based.
Right.

But now most of the work that I do focuses on our, our portfolio which is tends to be made up of, you know, large size scaled global companies that have massive amount of content and a massive amount of need for that content to get out to the market in really relevant consumer facing ways and huge organizations to manage it that need help getting stuff done.
So that tends to be our ideal customer.

What leads you to me in the.

Internal studio, but she already told me.

That's just like, you can't count on that.

We get it done.

summary.overview:
- **Company Overview:** Imaginary Content excels in e-commerce content creation for CPG brands like Kraft Heinz and Tyson.

- **Growth Metrics:** IM has grown to create 300 videos for Facebook and 100 for eBay over the last eight years.

- **Financial Performance:** IM forecasts 2024 revenue similar to 2023, with over $3 million in committed contracts secured early.

- **Operational Efficiency:** IM employs manual processes; explores AI for copy generation, but relies on human oversight due to legal risks.

- **Client Relationships:** High retention rates stem from strong partnerships and responsiveness, with long sales cycles requiring patience.

- **Acquisition Fit:** ICP values IM for its creative talent and culture; integration aims to enhance content capabilities without losing quality.
summary.short_summary: Imaginary Content (IM) is a nimble, founder-led company specializing in e-commerce content creation for CPG brands, having grown significantly over the past eight years under CEO Ilene Richardson. With a strong EBITDA margin of 25-30%, IM expects 2024 revenue to match 2023 levels, driven by over $3 million in committed contracts. The company relies on manual processes for content production, emphasizing high client retention through strong partnerships and responsiveness. ICP, a global MarTech consultancy, sees IM as a strategic fit to enhance its digital shelf capabilities, particularly in the CPG sector. The acquisition process is underway, with both sides prioritizing cultural and operational integration to ensure a successful partnership.
